propositions: The review bot fetches a tree using patchSet.ref but casts votes against patchSet.revision, which are independently-supplied fields that may diverge
Without assertion, a stale clone, partial fetch, or refactored checkout logic can produce a tree that does not match the voted revision with no error signal
adapter.py:184 receives ref as a required positional parameter but does not use it, leaving the assertion unimplemented
FETCH_HEAD must be asserted equal to patchSet.revision after fetch and checkout to bind the reviewed tree to the vote
A revision mismatch must refuse to vote and fail-closed with an actionable error message
